source.par_clim: Average of the daily-mean surface PAR, PAR at 1 m, and water temperature across 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 (same calendar day each year) - EDI knb-lter-ntl.129; 2016-2020 excluded for under-water sensor fouling
source.metabolism_avg: Bookkeeping GPP/ER computed with a measured mixed-layer depth (thermistor chain, EDI knb-lter-ntl.130; density threshold 0.1 kg/m3; calendar-day climatology where a year has no chain data) separately for 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 7-day-median smoothed per year, then averaged by calendar day
